messages:
andre: audit-alerts flagged an abnormal read pattern from `service-linker@prod` to multiple customer buckets at ~02:14 UTC. this started right after last night's role-schema rollout. can we confirm scope?
sec-bot: automated alert: 2418001234-ALERT - principal=service-linker@prod action=s3:GetObject resource=customer-data/* count=142 first_seen=2024-11-14T02:14:07Z
leah: ack. i'm looking at the role-mapper diff from the release. pinging infra to pause the rollout. @sam can you stop the job? :pray:
sam: stopping rollout now (deploy-job-id: rl-8321) 
Leah: found a binding with a wildcard match in the new role template: `resource: "customer-data:*" -> allow: read` — that should have been namespaced. sending diff:```
- roles/service-linker:
-  - resources: ["customer-data:*"]
+ roles/service-linker:
+  - resources: ["customer-data:${project}"]
```
andre: confirmed — mapper expanded `*` for org tenants during template render. that caused cross-tenant reads.
maria: immediate containment plan: 1) remove the cluster-level binding for service-linker 2) disable the service account 3) rotate keys 4) enable object-level audit logging (if not already) 5) run focused replay to enumerate reads. doing 1-2 now.
nora: i'm running `gcloud iam service-accounts disable service-linker@prod` then removing `binding: service-linker-read` from iam policy. will share commands shortly.
leah: also pushing a quick server-side deny rule to block reads from that SA until we fix the template:```
apiVersion: v1
kind: DenyPolicy
spec:
  principal: service-linker@prod
  deny:
    - action: s3:GetObject
    - action: s3:ListBucket
```
sam: done: rollout stopped, CR binding deleted. service account disabled. logs show reads stopped at 02:18 UTC.
sec-bot: audit-log snippet (sanitized):```
[02:14:07] service-linker@prod GET customer-data/tenant-42/records.csv
[02:15:03] service-linker@prod GET customer-data/tenant-17/config.json
[02:16:55] service-linker@prod GET customer-data/tenant-99/personal_notes.txt
```
andre: thx. can compliance confirm if any PII or regulated datasets were accessed? @maria pls coordinate.
maria: engaging compliance. initial scan: 9 objects accessed, 3 flagged as sensitive (hashed ids present). no plaintext SSNs shown. I'm running a deeper content check now.
nora: rotating keys and creating incident-specific service account for safe replay: `service-linker-incident` with scoped read only to our test tenants.
leah: root cause writeup (short): templating bug allowed global `*` expansion for `resource` field when `project` variable missing during render. fix: validate templates in CI and fail on wildcards in production role templates.
sam: i've reverted the role-schema rollout and created PR to add a template linter. will follow up with canary that asserts per-tenant scoping.
maria: compliance: we should notify affected customers per policy if any regulated data was exposed. opening a data-access notification draft.
andre: action items assigned: leah => patch template renderer + deploy linter; sam => add canary + rollback tooling docs; nora => rotate creds + provide replay logs; maria => compliance/notification draft; infra => enable object-level audit retention 90 days.
leah: small hotfix pushed to block wildcard rendering. rolling to staging for 10m smoke.
sec-bot: incident ticket created: INC-2024-5143 (link: https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-2024-5143)
sam: smoke looks good, staging canary passed. scheduling controlled rollout with manual approval.
maria: compliance: draft notification ready, holding until legal sign-off.
andre: final note: we should add a CI gate that rejects role templates containing `*` or missing templating vars. also add a daily audit query looking for any cross-tenant reads originating from infra SAs.
leah: agreed. adding to sprint. closing slack loop here, will update incident ticket as we progress. :white_check_mark:
